notes.title: Thanks for playing and 1.0.1 patch notes!
notes.notes: [p]First of all thanks a lot to everyone who played Kity Builder! We've loved watching your streams, screenshots in Steam Workshop and of course your very nice reviews 😻.[/p][p][/p][p]The team has taken a small break after all the hard work that went into releasing the game in the best shape we could, but since a few bugs and typos went under our radar, we've fixed those:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed English typos and strings that were in the wrong place[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can use the R00MB4 to paint a few zones you couldn't before[/p][/*][*][p]Updated a few names in the credits[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We look forward to sharing more news with you, but for now, we'll keep enjoying our little summer break from working on the game :)[/p][p][/p][p][i]-Mau from Team Kity[/i][/p]

notes.title: Kity Builder is out now!!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! I’m Mau from Team Kity and we have some exciting news: Kity Builder is NOW AVAILABLE. 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t believe that we’ve finally reached the finish line. We’ve worked really hard on this game with the mission of delivering a smile to as many people as possible, so we hope you enjoy it as much as we loved making it. Remember that there aren’t any limits on how many buildings to place or how you should structure your creations in our game – just have fun, enjoy the chill and cozy vibes, and interact with your kitty friends!
[/p][p]Thank you for supporting us with your wishlists and excitement, it’s meant so much to the team. :-) We hope you have a purrfect time playing in our sandbox world. 
[/p][p]<3[/p]

notes.title: Sandbox city-building for cats - announcing Kity Builder!
notes.notes:
Hello Ar-cat-ects!

We’re excited to officially announce Kity Builder, our cozy sandbox city-builder about building cities for cats! Check out our brand new trailer below:

[previewyoutube=eUoOCcwzqMw;full][/previewyoutube]

We designed Kity Builder with creativity in mind, so there’s no time limits, resources or even money. You can take your time creating beautiful settlements and cities for the kitizens, and then sit back to watch them move in and make themselves at home. 

Buildings also double as toys, meaning you can use them to help you explore every nook and cranny on the island! Bounce, climb and fling yourself from place to place on your quest to find new blueprints and discover new places. 

We can’t wait to share more with you soon, but in the meantime be sure to follow us on social media and here on Steam for updates! 

Don’t forget to wishlist Kity Builder too! 

- Team Kity

notes.title: Kity Builder Demo on the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We got nice news: Kity Builder is participating in the Steam Next Fest (October 1-7) with a new demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40455904/fcd115f031c6501e10573cea017a45e3331a14d6.png[/img]
I never get tired of looking to our splash art, made by [url=https://twitter.com/ChipsGoWOAH]ChipsGoWoah[/url]

This is the first playable demo since we published the game on Newgrounds back in April. As you know, making full games is pretty damn hard but we are trying our best. We have improved a lot of things based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] 2 new islands to explore, with unique biomes and buildings
[*] More building types
[*] Rideable boat + explorable ocean
[*] Improved graphics
[*] Paths painter
[*] NPCs
[*] Dialogues
[/list]
We’ll also have a new trailer really soon, so if you wanna keep updated follow us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/KityBuilder]@KityBuilder[/url]) and wishlist the game here on Steam!
